description: The bar chart compares the performance of three models—RedWhale (our), Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across five evaluation tasks: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, and KoBEST-SN, with an additional average (AVG) metric. The vertical axis represents performance scores, with values ranging from 0.42 to 1.00, and the horizontal axis lists the evaluation tasks. For each task, three bars are displayed: a dark blue bar for RedWhale (our), a light blue bar for Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and a light gray bar for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). In all tasks, the base model (SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0) achieves a score of 1.00, serving as a reference point. RedWhale (our) consistently outperforms Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 across all tasks, with scores of 0.42 (PT-EVAL), 0.52 (KoBEST-BQ), 0.71 (KoBEST-CP), 0.50 (KoBEST-HS), and 0.69 (KoBEST-SN), compared to Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0's scores of 0.46, 0.56, 0.74, 0.54, and 0.73, respectively. The average performance for RedWhale (our) is 0.57, while Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 averages 0.61. The chart indicates that RedWhale (our) achieves higher performance than Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 in most tasks, with the exception of KoBEST-CP and KoBEST-SN, where Eevee-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 slightly outperforms RedWhale (our). The base model (SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0) consistently achieves the highest score of 1.00 in all tasks, suggesting it serves as a strong baseline.
